priority: existing review_only_pdf_parent_feo_candidates before externally unsourced cases
rules: A valid FeO row is accepted only when the table title or visually reviewed column identifies the candidate sample or a labeled fraction of it.
Is/FeO maturity numbers and Apollo sample identifiers are not FeO concentrations.
Values belonging to another table/sample are retained and reassigned, not deleted.
Component, coating/interior, magnetic fraction, lithology, and named subsample values are retained but not treated as parent-bulk FeO.
Repeated parser detections of the same cell are marked as duplicates.
